findings.title: Discount rate is a float instead of an int
findings.body: The new `spring_price_cents` function uses `rate = 0.2` (a float) while `apply_discount` expects `percent` to be an integer per its signature. Passing a float will cause a type mismatch and likely a runtime error. Use an integer rate (e.g., `20` for 20%) to match the function's contract.

summary.problem: The new sale price function uses a float discount rate where an integer is required, risking a runtime error.
summary.done_well: The function clearly documents its purpose and delegates discount calculation to a dedicated helper.
